selection: Purposive additional clear-date diagnostic set; expiry and relevant notice terms visible before any new model outputs
deduplication_scope: Original document identities and prior company names compared; reformatted PDF hashes alone are not evidence of non-overlap
input_format: PDF reading copies of full downloaded HTML exhibits; not original PDF layout; originals enclosed
limitations: Not a representative random sample and not a replacement for the original held-out test.
Base agreements referenced by amendments are not enclosed. Only the uploaded amendment text may be used.
Some notice rules have approval/default/early-termination conditions. Human review may still be appropriate.
Historical first or revised terms only; current renewal cycles and subsequent amendments are not verified.
Review receipt/delivery requirements separately from arithmetic notice boundaries.
